form.message: Project Fulcrum — required secret handling and implementation policy scope. A separate public-documentation finding excludes the preferred Key Vault candidate under the current boundary: vault contents replicate automatically from Sweden Central to paired Sweden South. The settled Entra-only exception is unchanged and does not cover this. Key Vault is a preference, not a locked SKU, so this does not prove the workload impossible. Before selecting a compliant alternative, clarify the required dev secret/certificate categories; do not assume a secretless image or silently drop secrets management. Any requested Key Vault residency exception must return to the Requirements owner. Separately, implementation Gate 2 requires current preliminary policy feasibility for a securely authorized target. This is not SKU confirmation, Gate 2 approval, spending permission or Azure-read authorization.

dev_secret_certificate_profile.title: Dev backend — required secret and certificate categories
dev_secret_certificate_profile.description: State whether managed identities plus platform-provided HTTPS can cover every required dev connection, or describe the categories of non-managed-identity credentials/custom certificates and their retrieval, rotation and audit needs. Categories only: never supply secret values, real domains, identities or contacts. If the application team has not confirmed this, say so. No extra external integration, application implementation or residency exception is assumed.

policy_feasibility_read_intent.title: Dev policy feasibility — secure target/read-scope intent
policy_feasibility_read_intent.description: Choose the route; do not enter confidential tenant, subscription or resource identifiers here. For Governance reads, the parent must separately bind the actual authorized dev target, inherited-policy read scope and permitted operations through an approved secure channel. This field records intent only. Without current policy feasibility, local research can remain provisional but final implementation Gate 2 is unavailable.
enumNames: Arrange a securely scoped dev target for read-only preliminary Governance discovery
Target not yet available — retain local/public planning only and the final Gate 2 hold

residency_requirement.workload: Sweden Central only for workload compute, application data, storage and backups; retain the existing single-region boundary for non-Entra services, monitoring and other dependencies.
residency_requirement.microsoft_entra_identity_exception: Accept Microsoft Entra identity's documented European customer data storage and processing behavior at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/fundamentals/data-storage-eu, including its documented qualifications and limited temporary or permanent transfers. Most customer data within the EU Data Boundary is not an absolute no-EU-egress guarantee.
residency_requirement.applicability_prerequisite: Architecture must verify tenant creation/provisioning and exact identity-product coverage for workforce and external Volunteer sign-in, including Entra External ID external-tenant applicability; no applicable tenant or deployed commitment is verified here.
residency_requirement.excluded_permissions: No general global-service, monitoring, storage or other integrated-service exception; no automatic permission for optional multitenant collaboration, Application Proxy or other optional cross-boundary features; no law, effective-policy or security-baseline waiver.
residency_requirement.acceptance_scope: Project Stakeholders accept this narrow exception as meeting their project GDPR requirements. This is not independent certification, blanket GDPR compliance assurance, architecture approval or Azure read/write, spend, Production or deployment authority.
